title: Be prepared hub
script:
repeat task.wait(1) until math.random(1,30) == 1

local ssj4 = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", game.Lighting)
ssj4.TintColor = Color3.new(1,0,0)
ssj4.Brightness = 0.5
ssj4.Contrast = 5

local e =" ROBU"
local b = "KED B"
local g = "HACK"
local a = "HAC"
local c = "Y 1x1x"
local f = "X TO UN"
local d = "1x1\n5k"
local daima = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)


local ssj4check = Instance.new("TextLabel", daima)
ssj4check.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
ssj4check.Text = a..b..c..d..e..f..g
ssj4check.TextScaled = true
ssj4check.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
daima.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None

while task.wait(0.05) do
    if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
        game.TweenService:Create(ssj4check, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
    else
        game.TweenService:Create(ssj4check, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
    end
end
